warnings: preserve is 65 % of the expected final part (123984 mm3 of 190514 mm3 at volfrac 0.06). Most of this shape is drawn, not optimised; say so wherever the result is presented.

the free region is only 2.0 voxels (6.00 mm) thick at its thinnest. Below about 3 voxels there is no room for a hole, so the topology there is set by the outline rather than chosen -- refine the grid or widen the design space.

the 2 support point(s) are fixed by preserve at hp4_seat at [0.0, 76.0, 169.4]; hp5_seat at [0.0, 76.0, 100.5]. Where the part is held is an input to this study, not a result of it -- if the layout of the supports is itself meant to be optimised, that decision is currently being made in CAD.

info.note_preserve_bodies: 5 separate preserve bodies, all reachable through the design space -- that is the normal generative-design setup.
